name: Yamanaka
traits:
[BOX]
| Mind Body Transfer – Mental Overwrite / Max Ranks: 5, [Mental], [Sensory] / Pockets of the casters consciousness are overwriting yours. Your thoughts become hazy. Your movements sluggish and you begin to believe, not even your own. The strength of this jutsu depends on the mental strength of the target. Creatures lose 1 rank of Mental Overwrite at the end of each of their turns, unless they are Dominated. / Applies to Minions / With 1 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated (see effect), until dispelled. / Applies to Standards / With 3 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated for up to 1 hour. / This Dominated creature remakes their saves at the end of each of their turns, ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Elites / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated for up to 1 minute. / This Dominated creature remakes their saves at the end of each of their turns. ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Solo’s / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated until the end of their next turn. ending the condition and removing all ranks. / Applies to Player Characters / With 5 rank of Mental Overwrite, the afflicter can choose to make the affected creature becomes Dominated, remaking their saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending it on a successful save. |
[/BOX]
Recommended Ability Score Increase: +2 Wis or Int, +1 Cha
Speed: 30 feet.
Skill Proficiencies: Illusions, Insight
Yamanaka Techniques: The Yamanaka Clan has access to a separate list of jutsu unique to their clan. You can add these Jutsu to your jutsu list instead of selecting jutsu from the normal jutsu list(s).
Hijutsu Flexibility: Yamanaka Clan Hijutsu can use either Intelligence or Charisma as its casting ability score.
Telepathic Comms: Once per long rest, select a number of willing creatures equal to 1+Proficienty bonus that you can reach during this rest. Until you all complete a long rest, you can telepathically communicate with one another, conveying your thoughts to one another at will, so long as you are within 1 mile of each other. If any of you are ever in a structure with chakra based or enhanced walls, you cannot communicate with that creature using this trait.
